neighbours.label: the slot right before 'needed/required' in a statement of need (are [urgently] needed, we desperately need)
fire: Larger randomized studies are needed before this drug can be recommended.
Our town desperately needs a second hospital for the growing population.
Additional funding is urgently required to keep the shelter open this winter.
Better tools for early diagnosis are sorely needed in rural clinics.
Volunteers are badly needed to help sort donations at the food bank.
Long-term data on the vaccine's effects are still needed, the authors write.
The region urgently needs clean water after the floods destroyed the pipes.
New approaches to treating resistant infections are clearly needed.
quiet: Two large randomized studies have recently tested this drug in older adults.
Our town opened a second hospital for the growing population last year.
Last winter the shelter stayed open thanks to a generous donation.
In rural clinics, nurses use simple tools for early diagnosis.
Many volunteers helped sort donations at the food bank on Saturday.
The authors write that the vaccine was well tolerated in the first year.
After the floods destroyed the pipes, the region relied on bottled water.
Doctors have tried several approaches to treating resistant infections.

notes: Card: peaks ' are'/' is' before ' needed', ' urgently', ' desperately'; logit effect of the - pole promotes ' needed', ' need', ' necessary'. Probe: 'are urgently needed' 0.72, 'badly need' 0.44, but 'trials are currently underway' 0.25, so near misses avoid the 'X are' frame.
